name: Observatory dome
desc: Looking outward: long nights, patience, and the smallness that comes afterwards.
tags: observatory dome interior, large telescope on an equatorial mount, open dome slit, night sky through the slit, curved dome wall panels, steel gantry stairs, control desk with monitors, cables across the floor, red work lights, ladder to the eyepiece, swivel chair
prose: the interior of an observatory dome, a great telescope on its mount angled up toward an open slit in the curved roof, night sky showing through the gap and a control desk glowing at the edge of the floor
note: This is the one in the set the model has least of, and it collapses into a PLANETARIUM - rows of seats, stars projected on a smooth ceiling - unless the open slit and the mount are named. The slit with real sky in it is the noun that rescues the shot; add the curved panel seams and the gantry stairs and it stops being a dome-shaped auditorium. Telescope geometry falls apart in close-up, so frame the instrument whole and at distance. Darkness is graded, with the red work lights as the only source worth naming.
